name: dineos-widget
description: Build tooling for the embeddable DineOS ordering widget. Source lives in src/widget/; the build bundles it into a single minified static/widget.js (IIFE, no deps) plus a sourcemap, so the embed stays plug-and-play.

scripts.build: npm run build:widget && npm run build:admin
scripts.build:admin: esbuild static/js/sfetch.js static/js/admin.js static/js/admin-header.js static/js/manager.js static/js/availability.js static/js/kitchen.js static/js/reports.js static/js/qr.js static/js/settings.js static/js/login.js static/js/staff.js static/js/kitchen-login.js static/js/manager-login.js static/js/forgot-password.js static/js/reset-password.js --bundle=false --minify --target=es2017 --outdir=static/js/dist
scripts.build:dev: npm run build:widget:dev && npm run build:admin:dev
scripts.build:widget:dev: esbuild src/widget/index.js --bundle --format=iife --target=es5 --outfile=static/widget.js --banner:js="/* DineOS widget — dev bundle */"
scripts.build:admin:dev: esbuild static/js/sfetch.js static/js/admin.js static/js/admin-header.js static/js/manager.js static/js/availability.js static/js/kitchen.js static/js/reports.js static/js/qr.js static/js/settings.js static/js/login.js static/js/staff.js static/js/kitchen-login.js static/js/manager-login.js static/js/forgot-password.js static/js/reset-password.js --bundle=false --target=es2017 --outdir=static/js/dist
scripts.check: npm run check:bundle && npm run test
